model.src:
(block System
  :type "Module"
  (sketch "A randomly generated system for testing layout rules.")
  (message Request (sketch "A request."))
  (message Event (sketch "A event."))
  (message Snapshot (sketch "A snapshot."))
  (message Command (sketch "A command."))
  (message Receipt (sketch "A receipt."))
  (behavior Durable (port keep in Event) (sketch "Retains events until acknowledged."))
  (behavior Observable (port metric out Snapshot) (sketch "Reports its own health."))
  (level
    (adjacent
      (block ShadowQueue
        (implements Durable)
        (sketch "Turns raw input into typed commands and rejects anything malformed before it reaches storage."))
      (block LocalSync :type "Service"
        (port evt in Command)
        (port out out Command)
        (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen."))
      (block ShadowSession
        (port in in Event)
        (port out out Request)
        (implements Durable)
        (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at.")
        (level
          (adjacent
            (block Pricing :type "Store"
              (port evt in Event)
              (implements Durable)
              (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at."))
            (block EdgeInbox
              (port req in Event)
              (port out out Command)
              (implements Observable)
              (sketch "Keeps the latest state per key."))))
        (level
          (block Audit :type "Feature"
            (sketch "Keeps the latest state per key."))
          (block LocalBilling :type "Process"
            (port req in Request)
            (port done out Event)
            (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen.")
            (level
              (block RemoteGateway
                (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at."))
              (adjacent
                (block EdgeSync
                  (port req in Snapshot)
                  (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind."))
                (block Router
                  (port in in Request)
                  (implements Observable)
                  (sketch "Thin wrapper."))
                (block ShadowEditor :type "Feature"
                  (port in in Request)
                  (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at."))))
            (level
              (block EdgeCatalog
                (port in in Event)
                (implements Durable)
                (sketch "Turns raw input into typed commands and rejects anything malformed before it reaches storage."))
              (block ShadowBilling
                (port req in Snapshot)
                (implements Durable)
                (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen."))))))
      (block RemoteUploader
        (port req in Request)
        (port out out Request)
        (implements Observable)
        (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at.")
        (level
          (block RetryAudit
            (port in in Receipt)
            (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at."))
          (adjacent
            (block BatchParser
              (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen.")
              (level
                (adjacent
                  (block EdgeSession
                    (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at."))
                  (block BatchBilling
                    (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen.")))
                (adjacent
                  (block ShadowScheduler
                    (implements Observable)
                    (sketch "Turns raw input into typed commands and rejects anything malformed before it reaches storage."))
                  (block RetryPlanner
                    (port evt in Request)
                    (port out out Receipt)
                    (sketch "Thin wrapper."))
                  (block Ledger :type "Service"
                    (port evt in Request)
                    (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind.")))))
            (block BatchFeed :type "Feature"
              (implements Observable)
              (sketch "Keeps the latest state per key.")
              (level
                (block BatchCatalog :type "Process"
                  (port req in Request)
                  (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen."))
                (block LiveAuth :type "Service"
                  (port evt in Snapshot)
                  (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind."))
                (block LiveLedger :type "Process"
                  (port done out Command)
                  (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind."))))
            (block Search
              (port out out Event)
              (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind.")
              (level
                (block Auth
                  (port in in Command)
                  (implements Observable)
                  (sketch "Turns raw input into typed commands and rejects anything malformed before it reaches storage."))
                (adjacent
                  (block RetryInbox
                    (port out out Request)
                    (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen."))
                  (block RetryRouter
                    (port in in Event)
                    (port done out Event)
                    (sketch "Turns raw input into typed commands and rejects anything malformed before it reaches storage."))
                  (block RetryGateway :type "Feature"
                    (port in in Receipt)
                    (port emit out Snapshot)
                    (sketch "Keeps the latest state per key."))
                  (block Sync
                    (port evt in Event)
                    (implements Observable)
                    (sketch "Thin wrapper."))))
              (level
                (adjacent
                  (block LocalRouter :type "Process"
                    (port req in Snapshot)
                    (port done out Request)
                    (implements Durable)
                    (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at."))
                  (block RetryScheduler
                    (port evt in Receipt)
                    (sketch "Keeps the latest state per key.")))
                (adjacent
                  (block LiveSearch
                    (port emit out Command)
                    (sketch "Thin wrapper."))
                  (block RemoteFeed
                    (port req in Receipt)
                    (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind.")))))))
        (level
          (block LocalMetrics
            (port in in Receipt)
            (sketch "Thin wrapper."))
          (block RetrySync
            (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at."))
          (block Billing
            (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at."))))))
  (level
    (adjacent
      (block RetryEditor
        (port done out Request)
        (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen."))
      (block LiveSync
        (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen."))
      (block Profile
        (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen.")))
    (block RetrySession :type "Feature"
      (port evt in Snapshot)
      (port emit out Receipt)
      (implements Durable)
      (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at."))))
